consequence.statement: A new Helm configuration option is available to customize the API version of the PodLog CRD; environments that do not use this option are unaffected

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds a new Helm value to make the API version of the PodLog CRD configurable.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: evidence names the feature as 'configurable API version for PodLog CRD' but does not specify the exact Helm value path or configuration key name; applicability: evidence does not specify which Helm values or environments are affected by this new configurability; whether this exposes existing behaviors or changes defaults is not stated
